verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right banner flow with the headline, two-line subcopy and CTA in one aligned right column. However, the NEW FLAVOR badge is jammed into the top-left corner, the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and floats unanchored, and the CTA almost touches the bottom edge. B breaks the headline awkwardly across lines ('Chase the / Light') and crushes the subcopy into a ragged five-line sliver that is separate from both the headline and the CTA. It also strands the badge inside a decorative circle and puts the headline over a circle, so the right side looks cluttered and has no clear grid.
